title: [SOLVED] Turn off all but one monitor when in linux console?
body: So I have a dual-monitor setup consisting of a 1440p main screen and a 1080p secondary screen to my right, and I get these really ugly borders on my main screen when I use the linux console. I'm making an educated guess in that the console has to fit on all screens, so it chooses the smallest resolution and goes with that. The problem is, I use ly-dm as a login manager and as you could probably infer, it really doesn't look good on my 1440p. Here's a quick graphic (exaggerated): __________ | | | | | | |------ | | | ---------- The smaller part is the actual rendered part, where ly (and the console) is. The bigger part is just black. My question is thus as follows: Is there a way to turn off all but one monitor specifically in the linux console only? And if not, how can I make my 1440p screen 1080p only in the linux console?
